headline: 13 core protocol contracts catalogued on Cronos; 4 audits from SlowMist and BlockSec (2021–2023)
short_headline: 13 contracts on Cronos; audited by SlowMist, BlockSec

findings.text: Block-explorer search on Cronoscan returned TONIC token contract (0xDD73dEa10ABC2Bff99c60882EC5b2B81Bb1Dc5B2) and holders including vault (0xff9361dFF9F485f563B6e947B4ADc51F9190a2c8); confirmed Cronos chain as deployment target

Official deployments doc located at https://tectonic.gitbook.io/docs/developer/smart-contracts-and-security; lists 13 named contract addresses across TectonicCore, TectonicSocket pools, TONIC token, staking, airdropper, boost, vault, and leverage tools

Four audit reports identified: SlowMist (Dec 2021), SlowMist & BlockSec (Mar 2022 staking), BlockSec (Dec 2022 isolated pools), SlowMist (Apr 2023 collateral repay/swap); audit PDFs available via GitBook but scope addresses not yet extracted
No GitHub repository URL recorded in protocol.github field; D4 block-explorer-inferred source code links not yet traced
Single chain (Cronos) in scope; D5 multi-chain enumeration not applicable
TectonicSocket listed as pool manager at three addresses (Main, Veno, DeFi); factory enumeration deferred pending read-API verification of child pools

Role taxonomy applied: TectonicCore (router/core), TectonicSocket (pool/router), TONIC (token/governance), staking/vault (vault/treasury), airdropper (other), timelock vesting (timelock), boost (governance), leverage tools (other)
All 13 addresses traced to fetched GitBook docs; no snippet-only sightings

rationale.verdict: Discovery walk completed via website and official docs. 13 protocol-level addresses catalogued from D2; 4 audits identified but scope addresses not yet extracted from PDFs. No GitHub source repo pinned; D4 source-walk deferred. Cronoscan search (D1) confirmed core token. Single-chain Cronos deployment. Factory enumeration (D6) capped pending read-API.

evidence.shows: 13 named contract addresses: TectonicCore, TectonicSocket (3 pools), TONIC token, TONIC airdropper, timelock vesting, staking pool, xTONIC, boost contract, vault, and deferred liquidity checks; all on Cronos with linked Cronoscan URLs

Four audit reports: SlowMist (Dec 2021), SlowMist & BlockSec (Mar 2022 staking module), BlockSec (Dec 2022 isolated pools), SlowMist (Apr 2023 collateral repay/swap); PDFs linked but not yet crawled for scope addresses
Official website confirms Tectonic as lending/borrowing platform on Cronos, powered by TONIC token; links to GitBook docs and community channels
TONIC token (CRC20) verified on Cronoscan; 36,837+ holders; confirms Cronos mainnet deployment

protocol_metadata.about: Tectonic is a decentralized lending and borrowing protocol built on the Cronos blockchain, enabling users to deposit supported tokens to earn passive interest and borrow assets by providing collateral. The platform uses an algorithmic interest rate model inspired by Compound and is governed by the TONIC token, with multiple isolated lending pools (Main, Veno, and DeFi) supporting different asset classes and strategies.
